subject: Meridian Labs — go-live coordination & CS ownership
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@meridianlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Meridian Labs — go-live coordination & CS ownership

Team,

Quick summary and context so CS can take over planning for Meridian's launch:

- ARR / commercial: $420k annual contract; SOW attached (Meridian_SOW_v3.pdf).
- Committed go-live: target week of Sep 8, 2025 (preferred).
- Why this is sensitive: PHI-handling, customer expects VPC connector and dedicated capacity during pilot.
- Integrations: SAML SSO (IdP: Okta), S3 data ingress with nightly deltas, and an existing PostgreSQL replica for metadata sync.
- Expected load: ~60 rps peak during initial pilot, ramp to ~250 rps over 4 weeks.

Open/risks for CS to own:
1) Security questionnaire pending (I've attached the latest Meridian_Security_QA.xlsx they sent).
2) Procurement expects DocuSign SOW to be executed before we start provisioning Dedicated capacity.
3) Meridian wants a 2-week freeze window for model changes during pilot.

Asks:
- Marissa: can you own the onboarding PM and lead kickoff cadence?
- Vanessa: can you take technical onboarding (SAML, S3, VPC peering) and be the primary engineer?
- Karthik: please confirm capacity reservation timeline and any infra prerequisites.
- Aisha: please confirm the SSO admin contact and whether Meridian's security team needs an architecture call this week.

Proposed kickoff options: Tue Aug 26 or Thu Aug 28 (30–60 minute pre-kick to align tech and security).

Thanks — I'll remain in the thread through provisioning.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128

Attachments: Meridian_SOW_v3.pdf, Meridian_Security_QA.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@meridianlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meridian Labs — go-live coordination & CS ownership

Thanks Jonas — good summary. I'll own the onboarding engagement and will act as Meridian's Customer Success Lead for the pilot.

Quick plan and assignments:
- Owner (onboarding PM): Marissa Cole (I will run weekly checkpoints and the kickoff).
- Technical owner: Vanessa Ortiz (implementation engineer) — Vanessa, please scope the SAML and VPC steps and list dependencies.
- Technical escalation: Karthik, please confirm when we can have Dedicated capacity reserved; we need that before the scheduled provisioning window (aim for provisioning the week of Aug 25).

Immediate next steps:
- I will schedule a 45-minute kickoff on Tue Aug 26 at 10:00am PT — provisional invite to follow.
- Vanessa, please prepare a short pre-kick checklist (SAML metadata, network CIDR list, S3 bucket policies, certs).
- Jonas, please get DocuSign executed; procurement would like billing contact: procurement@meridianlabs.com.

Notes / internal risks:
- Security QA has a few items flagged (data retention policies and KMS key rotations). We'll need to loop Security Ops if they don't accept our standard KMS pattern.
- If DocuSign isn't signed by Aug 22, we may need to push the provisioning date by one week.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 650-555-3412

Hi Marissa / Jonas,

Thanks — appreciate the clear asks. Confirming:
- Kickoff: Tue Aug 26 at 10:00am PT works for our team.
- Our technical lead for SSO/VPC will be Ben Ortiz (ben.ortiz@meridianlabs.com). Ben will join the kickoff.
- Procurement: procurement@meridianlabs.com is handling the DocuSign signature; they will route the SOW to our legal and return this week.

One note: our security team requested a 30-minute architecture review with your Security Ops before provisioning — could we schedule that for Aug 25? If so, please include an agenda: network diagram + KMS/retention plan + data flow for PHI.

Ben, looping you in to confirm the SAML metadata and IP ranges.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Head of Product Operations | Meridian Labs
aisha.k@meridianlabs.com

Quick update from infra: we can reserve Dedicated capacity for the pilot but need DocuSign executed and a signed billing contact before we allocate GPUs. Provisioning ETA after sign: 5 business days.

Action items assigned:
- Karthik: I will kick off the provisioning request once I have confirmation of signed SOW (procurement contact copied).
- Vanessa: please confirm exact CIDR ranges and SAML ACS/Entity IDs by EOD Aug 22 so networking can begin firewall rules and peering prep.
- Marissa: schedule the Security Ops architecture review on Aug 25 (30 mins) and include the bullet list: network diagram, KMS approach, data retention SLA.

I'll update infra ticket RDW-INF-587 when provisioning is requested.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
